subject: Reseller & Referral: Redwood <> NimbleOps revenue-share negotiation
messages:
From: Alex Kim <alex.kim@nimbleops.com>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Potential reseller / referral partnership with NimbleOps

Hi Sergio,

Great to meet at the CloudMarketplace roundtable last week — Alex from NimbleOps here. We build a deployment/observability layer for ML infra and have a handful of enterprise customers asking for low-latency hosted inference integrations. Redwood’s performance profile checks the right boxes.

We'd like to explore a reseller/referral arrangement where NimbleOps can: (a) resell Redwood hosted API to our install base, (b) co-sell into joint opportunities, and (c) get referral credit for leads we bring. Key questions from our side:
- Target commission / revenue-share % for first-year ARR and ongoing renewals
- Lead registration / protection windows and process (HubSpot/POC funnel)
- Payment terms, invoicing cadence, reporting visibility
- Any minimums/exclusivity expectations

If you have a one-pager or term sheet we can review, please share. From NimbleOps we’d likely start with a small pilot (3 deals, ~$120k ACV combined) and scale from there.

Thanks,
Alex Kim
Head of Partnerships, NimbleOps
alex.kim@nimbleops.com
+1 (415) 555-0138

From: sergio_alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Alex Kim <alex.kim@nimbleops.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Potential reseller / referral partnership with NimbleOps

Alex — thanks for the note and great meeting you too.

High level: Redwood runs a simple partner program that supports three motions: referrals (one-time finder fee or first-year rev-share), resellers (we invoice and pay partner a % of collected revenue), and co-sell (shared pipeline with defined splits). For quick context, I attached our one-pager.

Initial proposal (pilot-friendly):
- Referral: 20% of first-year revenue for referred deals that convert within 90 days of registration.
- Reseller: 20% rev-share on net collected revenue for first 12 months, then 10% on renewals thereafter unless renegotiated.
- Co-sell: 50/50 split on partner-influenced services revenue; product revenue follows reseller terms above.
- Lead registration: HubSpot referral form + quarterly reconciliation; we protect registered leads for 90 days from registration date. Retroactive registration accepted up to 60 days with evidence.
- Payment terms: Net-45 after Redwood receives customer funds; standard partner reporting portal access.

No exclusivity required for the pilot. If NimbleOps commits to a GTM bundle or marketplace listing, we can consider accelerated tiers (e.g., +5 percentage points) tied to pipeline thresholds.

If that sounds reasonable I can spin up a term sheet and DocuSign.

Attachment: Redwood_reseller_one-pager.pdf (one-page outline)

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Head of Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0102

From: Alex Kim <alex.kim@nimbleops.com>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: Jamie Ortiz <jamie.ortiz@nimbleops.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Potential reseller / referral partnership with NimbleOps

Sergio — appreciate the quick reply and the one-pager. A few points from our GTM lead: 
- NimbleOps would prefer 25% for first year on reseller deals, given our plug-and-play integration and joint sales motions. We can accept the step-down but 10% on renewals feels low; propose 15%.
- Lead protection: 90 days is fine, but we need a firm API/portal for registration so our SDRs can log leads programmatically. Can Redwood provide a REST endpoint or HubSpot integration?
- Payment cadence: Net-45 is OK but 30 days would help our cash flow for resellers bundled with services.

We can take the pilot (3 deals) now if we can agree to 25%/15% and an API for registration. Happy to sign a short LOI and test.

Also curious if Redwood would offer any marketing co-funds for a joint webinar/demo.

Cheers,
Alex

On Wed, Mar 11, 2026 at 08:40 AM Alex Kim wrote:

From: sergio_alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>, dylan_brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Potential reseller / referral partnership with NimbleOps — need alignment

Team — looping you in on a inbound partner ask (NimbleOps). Summary:
- External asks: 25% first-year reseller, 15% renewals, API for lead registration, co-marketing funds. Pilot ~3 deals.
- Our initial offer: 20% / 10% step-down, 90-day lead protection, net-45.

Questions:
1) Margin impact: is 25% first-year acceptable for our hosted margins if we need deeper deal support?
2) Do we want to allow programmatic lead registration as a permanent API or a short-term CSV/portal for pilots?
3) Any recommended accelerators (e.g., +5% for >$500k pipeline, or co-marketing credits)?

My recommendation: stick to 20%/10% as baseline. Offer an alternate strategic tier: 25% first-year + 15% renewals for partners who: sign a 12-month marketplace listing commitment and deliver >$500k qualified pipeline in 90 days. Offer a small co-marketing fund (one-time $5k) for pilot webinars. Limit retroactive registrations to 60 days (proof required).

Priyom — can you run margin calc and legal redlines for the accelerated tier and a Net-30 payment change? Dylan — can you confirm feasibility of a temporary registration API vs. partner portal? Marissa — thoughts on commercial incentives and onboarding checklist.

Thanks,
Sergio

From: sergio_alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Alex Kim <alex.kim@nimbleops.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Reseller term sheet (updated) — Redwood <> NimbleOps

Alex — thanks for the candid asks and for being open to a pilot. Attached is an updated term sheet (Reseller_TermSheet_v2.pdf) that reflects what we can commit to for a pilot, plus an accelerated partner tier. Highlights: 
- Baseline pilot terms (no exclusivity): 20% rev-share on net collected product revenue for first 12 months; 10% on renewals unless the accelerated tier is triggered.
- Accelerated strategic tier: 25% first-year + 15% renewals if NimbleOps: (a) lists Redwood on the NimbleOps marketplace within 30 days of agreement; and (b) submits >$500k in qualified pipeline (HubSpot tracked) within 90 days.
- Lead registration: Programmatic API + portal for pilot. Registered lead protection: 90 days; retroactive registration allowed up to 60 days with evidence.
- Payment: Net-45; Redwood willing to consider Net-30 for strategic partner on the accelerated tier only (requires finance sign-off).
- Reporting: monthly partner statements; quarterly reconciliation and audit rights.
- Clawbacks: 6-months pro rata for refunds/chargebacks.
- Term: 12-month initial term with automatic renewal; 30-day termination notice.

Next steps: I can send this via DocuSign (link below) or we can redline in Google Docs. If you agree in principle, Jamie can sign and we’ll start onboarding.

Attachment: Reseller_TermSheet_v2.pdf
DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/initiations/ABC-Reseller-2026
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

Thanks — looking forward to piloting together.
Sergio
